_what: How a planned task is put on the person's own calendar as an event (timebox-policy.mjs), one row per choice of the `external_display` setting. `writes`: whether an event is made at all. `transparency`: how the event shows to others ('transparent' is free, 'opaque' is busy); `busy_when_at_risk` makes it busy only for a task at risk or whose priority is in `busy_priorities`, free otherwise. `visibility` maps the person's default todo privacy (private or visible) to the calendar event visibility. A task is at risk when it is placed after its deadline, or its deadline binds and falls within `at_risk_hours` of the placed end. Add a way to show by adding a row; the screen offers each row with its `label`.

off.label: Do not put planned tasks on my calendar

free.label: Put them on my calendar as free time

busy.label: Put them on my calendar as busy
